title: Present Perfect e Vocabulário do Cotidiano
rawContent: TODAY’S TAKEAWAYSGRAMMARVOCABULARYPRONUNCIATIONoven: fornobake: assarlose – lost – lost puddle: poçapoodle: raça de cachorroeat – ate – eaten have lunch: almoçarhurt: machucar, ferirFURTHER PRACTICE WITH PRESENT PERFECT CONNECTED TO NOWExample: - Lisa’s phone battery was at 35%, but now it’s at 100%.- Lisa has charged her phone.Present perfect: subject + have / has + past participleRegular verbs have the same form in past simple and present perfect.1. Sarah's hair was long. Now it is very short.Sarah has cut her hair.2. The floor was dirty. Now it is clean.The floor has been cleaned. – O chão foi limpo (by my sister)My sister has cleaned the floor. – Minha irmã limpou o chão.3. Mark's car isn’t in his garage. He is walking to work.Mark has sold his car. 4. The oven is warm and there is a cake on the table.My mother has cooked /baked a cake.5. They are standing outside because they don't have their keys.They have lost their keys.6. The ground is wet and there are puddles everywhere.It has rained.7. I am not hungry anymore. My plate is empty.I have eaten all the food. I have had lunch. 8. The TV is off and the room is quiet.My dad has slept. My dad has gone to bed.My dad has gone to sleep. 9. James has a bandage on his finger and he's in pain.James has cut his finger.James has hurt his finger.10. The email is in the draft box. Present perfect: I haven’t finished it yet.Present simple: I don’t finish any email I start. Past simple: I didn’t finish the email yesterday.11. I don't see my phone anywhere on the desk.Present perfect: It has been taken to a service shop / a technician / a repair shop.                It has been lost. Present simple: I always lose my cell phone.Past simple: I lost my cell phone yesterday.12. Her computer is off and she isn’t at her office desk. Present perfect: She had gone home.Present continuous: She is driving now.Present simple: She is happy.Past simple: She went away after class.13. The window is broken and there is a ball on the floor.14. People are leaving the cinema.15. I know this author. He’s very good.

enriched.title: Present Perfect e Vocabulário do Cotidiano
enriched.summary: Nesta aula, os alunos aprendem o uso do Present Perfect conectado ao momento presente, com foco na estrutura gramatical e exemplos práticos. Também são introduzidas novas palavras e expressões relacionadas ao cotidiano.

vocabulary.definition: A device used for baking or roasting food.
examples: The oven is warm and there is a cake on the table.

vocabulary.definition: To cook food using dry heat, typically in an oven.
examples: My mother has baked a cake.

vocabulary.definition: To fail to keep something or to have it taken away.
A small pool of liquid, especially of rainwater on the ground.
examples: The ground is wet and there are puddles everywhere.

vocabulary.definition: A breed of dog with curly hair, often associated with being elegant.

examples: I have eaten all the food.

vocabulary.definition: To cause pain or injury to someone or something.

grammar.explanation: The Present Perfect is used to discuss actions that happened at an unspecified time in the past but are connected to the present.
rules: Use for actions with relevance to now or ongoing actions.
commonMistakes: Using the past simple instead of the present perfect.

expressions.usage: Used to describe eating a midday meal.

practiceQuestions.question: Complete the sentence: Sarah's hair was long. Now it is very short. Sarah ______ her hair.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The Present Perfect is used because it connects a past action to the present state.

practiceQuestions.question: True or False: The sentence 'Mark has sold his car.' uses the Present Perfect tense.
practiceQuestions.explanation: It uses the Present Perfect due to the auxiliary verb 'has' and the past participle 'sold'.

culturalNotes: The Present Perfect tense is often used in British English for actions with present relevance, while American English sometimes prefers the past simple in similar contexts.
studyTips: Practice forming sentences with regular and irregular verbs in the Present Perfect.
Use real-life examples to connect the tense to everyday situations.
originalExamples: Lisa has charged her phone. (Lisa carregou o celular.)
Sarah has cut her hair. (Sarah cortou o cabelo.)
The floor has been cleaned. (O chão foi limpo.)
My sister has cleaned the floor. (Minha irmã limpou o chão.)
Mark has sold his car. (Mark vendeu o carro.)
My mother has baked a cake. (Minha mãe assou um bolo.)
They have lost their keys. (Eles perderam suas chaves.)
I have eaten all the food. (Eu comi toda a comida.)
My dad has gone to sleep. (Meu pai foi dormir.)
James has hurt his finger. (James machucou o dedo.)

warnings: practiceQuestions tem apenas 2 item(ns), recomendado mínimo de 3
